SQLite amalgamation 3.46.0 (2024), vendored verbatim from
https://www.sqlite.org/2024/sqlite-amalgamation-3460000.zip

SQLite is in the PUBLIC DOMAIN (https://www.sqlite.org/copyright.html) -- the
authors disclaim copyright. No modifications: sqlite3.c / sqlite3.h / shell.c
are the unmodified upstream amalgamation. Built for tobyOS as a Windows PE
(win-sqlite.exe) by the in-tree mingw clang to prove Track C runs a real,
off-the-shelf third-party database engine (milestone C18a). Build-time options
(SQLITE_THREADSAFE=0, OMIT_LOAD_EXTENSION, MAX_MMAP_SIZE=0) are standard embed
configuration; the engine source itself is unchanged.
